howToUse:
1. Fill in the invoice details (No, Date, Client).
2. Add your products or services in the Items section.
3. Customize your brand with your name and avatar.
4. (Optional) Upload a QR code for easy payments.
5. Click 'UNDUH INVOICE' to save the high-resolution image.
features:
• Live A4 Preview
• Dynamic Calculations
• QR Code Payment Support
